scope: Local synthetic fixtures only; no production credentials or Windows session used.

chromiumSqlite.platform: Linux Chromium, not Windows installed PWA
results: UI: approved device, local encryption and automatic download after opening a permitted document.
IndexedDB: no plaintext document title or PDF content; device signing key is nonextractable.
Reconnect: an already opened document updates automatically without reopening it.
Interrupted download: previous complete version preserved; next reconnect replaces it after verification.
Service worker: only public shell/icons cached; trial and private responses excluded.

Access routes: anonymous /admin logs in to provider panel; /entrar remains laboratory selection with provider/lab sessions; workspace form opens the actual laboratory; Contact links back to visible marketing.
Public navigation: visible links, pricing/demo anchors, FAQ, installation, trial, legal pages and published blog articles load; external references are listed separately.
Commercial root with backend 503: origin error remains visible, document manager is never substituted.
Commercial root without network: generic unavailable page, never the offline document manager.
Landing: annual plan persists into enquiry, mobile comparison fits, and a real CRM acceptance precedes confirmation.
Public trial: save/reload works and two browser contexts cannot share drafts.
Cold offline start: all app tabs closed and server unreachable; reopening restores encrypted document and PDF/attachment links after local unlock.
Reconnect after offline cold start: current document refreshes automatically.
Closed-app reconnect: reopening online validates and updates copies after local unlock, without reopening each document.
Service-worker update: encrypted document copies survive shell replacement and still unlock.
Simulated quota denial: previous copy preserved; automatic retry replaces it only after storage accepts the new complete version.
Individual deletion stays removed on sync; explicitly reopening in the online app prepares it again.
Device revocation: the next online validation purges local encrypted copies and blocks document access.
Explicit removal: encrypted document records and visible PDF blobs removed.
Logout: laboratory session closes and local document copies remain cleared.
